items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: I had a chance to kind of get even with him because he kept pumping me about this idea of multiple instruments.

ctx.x: I don’t know, I think he’s still there, but there’s a guy that nothing gets past him.

I had a chance to kind of get even with him because he kept pumping me about this idea of multiple instruments. And what you can get out of the instruments you play. And I insisted that there were no limitations to what you can get out of what instrument, it just hasn’t been discovered yet. And so he had this thing, it seemed like he was ready in advance, about how well there are limitations and you say it isn’t finished. But no one can say it until everything has been tried, he was kind of like, “What?” So I…
You had your own sound for sure. And most of the people who innovate aren’t aware that it’s a conscious effort I think. That’s what makes it so terrific.
